description: This file contains Cypress end-to-end tests for the password creation page during user registration in a web application. It verifies password input validation, matching, and successful account creation navigation.

methods.name: beforeEach
methods.description: Sets up the test environment by navigating to the password registration page before each test.

methods.name: it('requires password and confirmation with strength check')
methods.description: Verifies the presence and validation of password and confirm password inputs, including password strength and match validation.

methods.name: it('submits and navigates to login')
methods.description: Simulates a successful password registration and checks that the page navigates to the login screen.
